name: Paperclip
note: Agent org control plane. Verified working on the overnight bench — boots clean, embedded Postgres, telemetry off.

name: Hermes
note: Telegram-gateway agent runtime. My daily driver.

name: Headlong
note: Persistent agent harness. Installed on a Factory droid backend; first real run still pending.

name: Cabinet
note: Won my head-to-head demo comparison against two alternatives; full re-scaffold pending. Promising.

name: cloudflare-os
note: Lost the same head-to-head to Cabinet on my use case.

name: Synara
note: Desktop app builds and boots clean end-to-end (Bun + Electron). Works; not yet part of the daily stack.

name: Buzz
note: Block's agent workspace. Cloned, never judged — the source build wants multi-GB toolchain and disk ran out mid-bench. Prebuilt release is the easy path.

name: WUPHF
note: Weaker take on what Buzz does, with a restrictive license on top.

name: improve (shadcn skill)
note: Plan-cheap-execute optimization loop as a Claude skill. Cherry-picked from the bench.

name: davidondrej skill pack
note: Three skills kept after a security read: risky-changes (adapted), folder-specific-claude-md, effective-agent-skills.

name: lazyweb skill
note: Design-research skill pack with a curl|bash installer; paid tier can decrypt browser cookies. Only ever deliberately, with the cookie-decryption caveat in mind.

name: agent-browser
note: Browser automation CLI for agents — accessibility-tree snapshots at a fraction of screenshot token cost. Daily driver.
like: The accessibility-tree snapshots cost a fraction of what screenshots do. The project claims about 82 percent less; feels right in my use. The tree comes with element refs, so an agent clicks a named thing instead of guessing at pixel coordinates.

name: Firecrawl
note: Scrape/crawl/extract API for pages that fight plain fetch. Its X postprocessor is the only reliable way I read tweets programmatically.
like: Its X postprocessor is the only reliable way I read tweets programmatically.
why: When the job is to get the content, not to click through a UI. A page that blocks a plain fetch, a whole site I want as markdown, a structured field I want pulled out. If the job needs a login or real clicking, I reach for agent-browser instead.

name: Is Agentic
note: Score how ready a website is for AI agents, then get evidence and recommendations to improve it.

name: pxpipe
note: Token-saving MITM proxy with documented silent string corruption. Unusable anywhere fidelity matters.
dislike: It corrupts strings on the way through and says nothing about it. That is not my finding, it is in the project's own documentation. A proxy that quietly changes the bytes is worse than no proxy at all, because you do not find out where it broke, you find out somewhere downstream when a thing that should have matched does not. No token saving buys that back.

name: Dinky
note: Unsigned app from a personal tap — not worth the trust exception.

name: hubble.md
note: Duplicates my existing markdown vault workflow.

name: Macro
note: The workspace product turned out to be a Notion replacement, not the PDF tool I wanted.

name: Papercuts
note: Fine tool, but requires a Rust toolchain I don't want to carry right now.

name: Eve
note: Vercel's agent sandbox. Scaffolded and ready to test — needs Node 24.

name: Markdown Preview
note: Installed via Homebrew cask and verified signed. Not yet made the default or smoke-tested.

name: claudex
note: Claude Code's harness running on GPT-5.6 Sol through a local proxy. My delegation lane for big well-specified diffs.

name: Orca
note: Came out of my orchestrator comparison as the one to try next if mobile coding starts mattering. Watching until it does.

name: vgpu
note: A small WebGPU library from Vercel Labs with one API for browser canvases, headless Node.js and serverless runtimes, plus CLI and MCP discovery for agents.

name: Open Session
note: A self-hosted control room for running coding agents in isolated worktrees, sharing live sessions, and taking each run through diff review to a pull request.

name: swiped. | The Best Content in the Design Space
note: A weekly, hand-curated swipe file of high-performing design content from X and LinkedIn, useful for seeing what formats and ideas are working.

name: OpenInstinct — iMessage personal assistant + password vault
note: A self-hostable iMessage assistant that can browse and act for you while keeping credentials encrypted in your own stack; promising, but explicitly not production-ready.

name: AI accounting for startups in Stockholm — Bronn
note: An AI-native Stockholm accounting firm that combines automated bookkeeping with human sign-off, covering payroll, VAT, reporting and CFO advice.

name: Own Your AI: Apps, Models, and Infrastructure | Adapt
note: A full-stack platform for building company agents across Slack, GitHub, Linear and the web, with model routing, sandboxed infrastructure and deployable TypeScript.

name: Wist: AI Live Chat Agents for Customer Support
note: A no-code AI support chat builder that trains on websites and files, routes to humans, supports multiple models and mines conversations for product insights.

name: Shepherd by Can
note: A Grok bot template for orchestrating coding agents through Herdr, with explicit pane-layout and blocking-wait guidance.

name: Email Your ICP Website Visitors | Ploy
note: Ploy ranks identified website visitors by ICP fit, resolves one verified contact per company, and stages Gmail drafts for review without auto-sending.

name: Txt · Minimalist Text Editor for macOS
note: A native, local-first Mac text editor with quick notes, focus mode, Markdown and PDF export, and Apple Intelligence features; it's coming soon.

name: Circleback
note: AI meeting notes that capture transcripts, action items, searchable context, and automations across video calls and in-person conversations.

name: The Agency: AI Specialists Ready to Transform Your Workflow
note: A large collection of specialized agent personas and workflows, with installers for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, and other coding tools.

name: Agent Reach
note: A CLI capability layer that equips agents to read and search the web, YouTube, X, Reddit, GitHub, RSS, and several Chinese platforms.

name: codebase-memory-mcp
note: A local MCP server that indexes code into a persistent tree-sitter knowledge graph for fast structural queries, call traces, and impact analysis.

name: Diffusion Studio
note: An open-source desktop video editor and CLI that lets coding agents inspect footage, edit timelines, and leave every output editable in the UI.

name: Flexible Business Flight Finder | Free ChatGPT Skill
note: A free ChatGPT skill that searches flexible dates and trip lengths, then checks cabins, connections, seat availability, and stale fares before recommending business-class options.

name: Astro Themes & Tailwind CSS Templates | Lexington Themes
note: A collection of 133 production-ready Astro 7 themes with Tailwind CSS, including Sanity and EmDash CMS variants.

name: EmDash CMS
note: An open source, Astro-native CMS with typed schemas, secure plugins, and MCP APIs that humans and coding agents can both use.

name: Voyage AI | Home
note: Embedding and reranking APIs for semantic search and RAG, with general, domain-specific, and multimodal models.

name: Foundation
note: Chroma’s Foundation turns agent sessions into a versioned, cited team wiki and connects it to coding agents, Slack, MCP, a CLI, and an API.

name: Space | Infinite space on your computer.
note: A cloud filesystem that mounts in Finder, streams only the file ranges an app needs, and syncs edits across Macs without filling local storage.

name: DialKit — Tune interfaces in real time
note: A React toolkit for adding live controls beside an interface so you can tune animation, layout, spacing, and visual details in real time.

name: slot-text — tiny text roll animation
note: A tiny text-roll animation library with reduced-motion handling, screen-reader support, grapheme-aware transitions, and real-browser tests.

name: Kami — A Quiet Design System for Agent-Generated Documents

name: SEOmade — The Leaderboard of 975+ Startup, SaaS & AI Directories

name: LightReel: Your AI UGC Marketing Researcher
note: An AI research tool that searches TikTok and Instagram to find creators, track trends, study competitors, and improve UGC scripts and videos.

name: Meta Ads Skill for AI Coding Agents
note: An open-source agent skill for Meta API setup, campaign publishing, browser-only steps, and conversion-tracking verification drawn from production failures.

name: treg People Search for AI Agents
note: A metered people-search service that routes agents across dozens of providers for company data, contacts, verified work emails, and phone numbers.

name: Tailcat
note: A netcat-style CLI from Tailscale for short-lived encrypted connections between machines without accounts, tailnets, or IP addresses.
